## Real estate - Lead follow-up
**Sells:** Follow-up

Follows up every buyer lead on day 1, 3 and 7 and stops the moment the lead replies.

Run *Manual run* to execute on the built-in sample data. No credentials needed.

To go live: replace *Sample data* with the real source, *Draft message* with an LLM call, and the placeholder nodes with real send / approval steps.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(({json}) => ({json: {logged_at: new Date().toISOString(), automation: '04-real-estate-follow-up', record_id: json.id, to: json.to || null, subject: json.subject, approval: json.approval, status: 'draft_ready'}}));
